responsibility: This header declares the mc front end's lightweight formatted output API. It exports the fixed-arity printf and fprintf families that write translated escape-aware format strings to stdout or a specified FIO file, defining the compiler-support printing surface used by diagnostics and progress reporting code.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the public declaration layer for GmcPrintf.cc, listing the fixed-arity printf/fprintf entry points but not the internal format scanning, name-argument conversion, or output implementation.
